scenario: Raw bearer token is stolen from client/log.
controls: Hashed server session; no token telemetry; TLS; revocation.
Non-enumerating verification failure.
RL-AUTH-VERIFY + security metrics/alerts; thresholds configurable.

scenario: User changes object ID to access another task/profile/export.
controls: Server object authorization/default deny.

scenario: Personnel sync/provider tries to assign app role.
controls: Personnel authority excludes app role/status/privacy.

scenario: Role/status changed while session remains privileged.
controls: Current role/status each request; revoke security-sensitive sessions.

scenario: Raw task/profile content rendered as HTML.
controls: Output encoding, CSP, no trusted HTML by default.

scenario: Future cookie transport permits cross-site command.
controls: Bearer current; mandatory CSRF if cookie transport introduced.
Parameterized ORM/queries + typed DTOs.
No URL fetching/crawling in MVP; string-only storage.

scenario: Task text tries to override AI/system/business rules.
controls: Prompt isolation/schema validation; LLM cannot execute business arithmetic/auth.
Backend deterministic mapping only.

scenario: Malformed provider response changes domain state.
controls: Strict adapter schema/discriminated errors.

scenario: More personal/work data sent externally than needed.
controls: Data minimization; governance gate; no raw telemetry.
Transient transport; delete after STT/preview.

scenario: Key committed or exposed in frontend bundle/log.
controls: Secret manager references; CI secret/bundle scan; redaction.
Outbox/inbox/idempotency ledgers.

scenario: Repeated task finalization posts duplicate Score.
controls: Transactional idempotency + ledger source keys.
Atomic audit transaction; append-only application behavior.
Role scope at create and reauthorization at download.
Private bucket/object; application-authorized download/presign policy.

scenario: Exported user text executes formula in spreadsheet.
controls: Escape formula-leading fields during export.
Redaction matrix; bounded labels; no raw bodies.
Encryption at rest + restricted restore access.
Revoke/invalidate all restored sessions after recovery.
Lockfile, scans, provenance/checksums, gated build.
3D isolated; verified fallback; no auth/business dependency.
Async queues, concurrency controls, rate classes, backlog/latency alerts.
